Title: Power of One on non bleed action

Messages.Author: elotar
Messages.Body:
Can I play Power of One [pre] on non bleed action when in need of
stealth? All other +1 bleed/+1 stealth cards have text "(Only usable
on a bleed action.)", but not this one.

Power of One
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: anarch Obtenebration/Potence/Presence
Cost: 1 blood
Requires an anarch.
[obt] Only usable when an action is blocked. The blocking minion burns
2 blood or life (before combat, if any).
[pot] +1 bleed.
[pre] +1 bleed, or +1 bleed and +1 stealth. You cannot play another
action modifier to increase this bleed amount.

Rarity: TR:C

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 19 Dec 2010 09:30:16 -0800 (PST), elotar wrote:

>Can I play Power of One [pre] on non bleed action when in need of
>stealth?

No.

You can never add bleed to a non-bleed action.
There was no space for this reminder text on the card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. For stealth-only, you'd need text like: +1 bleed and/or +1
stealth.
